label: Coronation
notes: Favorite item quest step: Go to the Ark

lines.text: Time passes, and soon it's the day of the coronation.
As I stand among a crowd of fearsome-looking gang members,
sharp glares come at me from every direction. They must be wondering who the unfamiliar face is.
But this is exactly what I expected.
After all, my purpose from the start was to stand out.
*Rumble*
At last, the heavy doors swing open.
Rosanna slowly walks in.
Just one glance from Rosanna is enough to leave me overwhelmed.
... Who could possibly look into those eyes and still dare call her a fake?

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: Is everyone present?

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: We will now commence the Hedonia coronation ceremony.

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: This is a sacred ceremony. Any conduct unbecoming will not be tolerated.
One by one, the gang members step forward and drop to one knee.
Each takes Rosanna's hand and presses a kiss to the ring.
I'm stationed at the back with Marco's former men.
As I slowly scan the room for any sign of trouble...
All of a sudden,
something cold presses into my back.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Keep quiet.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Try anything funny, and you're dead.
... What do you want?

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Lemme ask you something.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: You're Rosanna's man, aren't you?
Murmurs ripple through the crowd.

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: ... What's all this commotion?

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: You there! Show some respect. You're in the middle of a ceremony.
Suddenly,
a giant of a man pushes through the crowd and emerges.
Just as expected, he's holding a ring.

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: It's you...!

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Brothers!
*Glint*

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Do you see this ring?

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: This is the real one!

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: The ring you swore your loyalty to is a fake!

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Rosanna's been playing you all for fools!

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: A fake ring for a fake boss!

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: ... I figured as much, but you've completely lost your mind.

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: Stealing the ring wasn't enough, huh? You even had the nerve to show yourself.

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: You're throwing your life away for nothing.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Are you so sure about that?

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Brothers... You haven't forgotten, have you?

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: How the boss we all served met his end that day.
A flicker of uncertainty crosses the faces of a few gang members.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: That's what happens when you rule through force and fear.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: People may seem loyal, but the moment doubt takes root, their trust starts to crack.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: I came here today fully prepared to lay down my life just to plant that seed.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: ... Heh,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: that's rich.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Who's doubting me? And who thinks they're bold enough to revolt?

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Yes... that's the reaction I'm looking for.
The burly man flashes a smug grin.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Rosanna,

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: the ring isn't the only thing you hold dear, is it?
In an instant, I'm yanked forward,
and a cold blade presses against my neck.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: How does it feel knowing your man's a hostage?
Everything has gone according to plan. Now it's time for me to make my move.
Rosanna's expression hardens in an instant.
Rosanna...?
She slowly starts walking toward me.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Just for today, I'll do things your way...
*Click-clack*
Rosanna keeps walking toward us.
She doesn't look remotely interested in listening to the burly man's threats.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: D-don't come any closer.
*Click-clack*
Her steps are measured, unhurried.
Yet the calm confidence she carries exudes an inexplicable sense of overwhelming presence.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: I said stay back!

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Damn you!

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: If you take one more step...!
With a soft swish,
a sharp blade stops just short of my throat.
Rosanna!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Sorry, Mister. I've changed my mind.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I thought I'd be fine with it, but after seeing it with my own eyes, I just can't.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Some filthy little rat actually had the nerve to lay its hands on what's mine.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: S-so that's how you're going to play it?!
Just before the blade can slice into my neck,
my body reacts on instinct.
*Whack!*
My elbow slams squarely into the man's side.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: Urgh...!
I can feel the strength draining from his body.
Hup!
The instant I see my chance, I throw him over my shoulder with everything I've got.
*Crash!*
To think I'd end up using the hand-to-hand combat I learned at the military academy here of all places...

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: ... Impressive.

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: I could've sworn he was twice your size.
Well... I may not look it, but I'm a soldier.
Suddenly,
we hear someone pick up a firearm behind us.
*Click*

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: Get down!
*Bang! Bang!*
I turn around to see
the large man sprawled on the ground, shot through both shoulders.

lines.speaker: suspiciousassociate
lines.text: *Cough...*

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Go ahead, try me.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You know how I am.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Once I decide something's mine, I never let anyone else have it.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Not my man. Not my ring.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hedonia's no different.
*Click*

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: And if someone takes it from me,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'll just take it back by force.
Rosanna, wait...!
*Bang! Bang! Bang!*
Gunshots ring out one after another.
A brutal reminder of the price of defying the boss of Hedonia.
*Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!*
And of the fate awaiting anyone who dares lay a hand on the boss's man.
Everyone present understands the message perfectly.
Rosanna squats down in front of the groaning, writhing giant of a man.
She snatches the ring from his hand and starts rolling it between her fingers.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Now, one last question.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Which one do you think is the real ring?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Ha.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: To think someone with your pathetic judgment would question my legitimacy.
*Wham!*
*Thud*

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: ... Take him away.

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: Right away.
The other gang members drag the man away.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: ... How many times have I told you?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I hate it when my things get damaged,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: so take better care of yourself.
Well, at least the ring escaped unscathed.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: There you go again, giving me that innocent look.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You're doing it on purpose, aren't you?
... Just kidding.
At least I did better than last time, right?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Ha,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: unbelievable.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Times like this make me think you might actually be even crazier than I am.
I'll take that as a compliment.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Think whatever you like.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Consigliere.

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: Yes, Boss.
Consigliere approaches and examines the spot on my neck where the blade grazed me.
I'm fine...

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: Please understand.

lines.speaker: consigliere
lines.text: If anything were to happen to you, our lives would be at risk as well.
... Okay.
Rosanna's gunshots usher in a new era,
once again impressing upon everyone present
who Hedonia's true ruler is.
